svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Where WordPress vulnerabilities were found in 2025
svg.desc: Patchstack logged 11,334 new WordPress ecosystem vulnerabilities in 2025, up 42 per cent year on year: 91 per cent in plugins, 9 per cent in themes and six in core. Of the total, 1,966 or 17 per cent were high severity, 46 per cent were unpatched when disclosed, and the median time from disclosure to first exploitation was five hours.
svg.text: PATCHSTACK, STATE OF WORDPRESS SECURITY IN 2026
